column1: # Pairs the duplicate report should and should not group, against a mastodon
# checkout (~/code/lib/ruby/mastodon).
# DRAFTED BY CLAUDE, NOT YET REVIEWED BY THE OWNER. Every verdict below was
# confirmed by reading both bodies against the labeling rule (DEC-020): a pair
# is a duplicate iff consolidating it would reduce net complexity.
# The third Ruby corpus, and the second app-shaped one. Where discourse's
# sharp edge was schema migrations (since path-classed, DEC-022), mastodon's
# is RAILS CONVENTION DISPATCH: byte-identical mailer actions whose behaviour
# differs only through the method's own name (template lookup, i18n subject
# key). Same arithmetic as the `super` pairs (DEC-017): the consolidation
# needs define_method metaprogramming, so it is not a finding. No path class
# can fence these — they are app code.
# CAVEAT on this checkout: its git history is a single squashed commit
# ("bench corpus for trekr", 2026-08), so `git log` proves nothing about
# copy direction here. Pair verdicts don't need direction; see canonical.tsv
# for what that caveat does cost.
# Near-candidates were sourced by sweeping --near-threshold down to 0.55 and
# reading, per the README's sourcing rule — never from the calibrated tier's
# own report. Measured jaccard noted per row; the threshold is 0.70.
# --- confirmed duplicates: consolidation reduces complexity ------------------
# Byte-identical batch-index loops; only the receiving index differs, and that
# is already a per-class `index` hook. Hoisting into Importer::BaseImporter is
# the template-method refactor.
Importer::InstancesIndexImporter#import!
# 17 identical lines of content negotiation; everything that differs lives in
# other methods (follows, collection_presenter). A shared base controller
# consolidates.
FollowerAccountsController#index
# Byte-identical actor-update fanout in the suspend and unsuspend services; a
# shared concern keeps behaviour intact.
SuspendAccountService#distribute_update_actor!
# Identical pure function copied between two CLI classes.
Mastodon::CLI::EmailDomainBlocks#color
# Identical memoized row count; ROWS_PROCESSING_LIMIT is 20_000 in both
# classes — the write_query? judgment from the rails set: one shared concern
# consolidates.
Admin::Import#csv_row_count
# Identical memoized domain-block check; ProcessStatusUpdateService copied it
# (with its neighbour unsupported_media_type?) from Create wholesale.
ActivityPub::Activity::Create#skip_download?
# Byte-identical between the v1 and v2 API controllers; only the serializer
# in the sibling actions differs. A shared base controller consolidates — API
# versions are live code, not frozen history like migrations.
Api::V1::Notifications::PoliciesController#set_policy
# The trends filter family: three byte-identical `results` scaffolds whose
# varying parts (initial_scope, scope_for) are already per-class methods. A
# base filter class is the consolidation.
Trends::PreviewCardFilter#results
# Byte-identical redis-socket checkin copied between the rack middleware and
# the sidekiq middleware; a shared module consolidates. (Its 4-line sibling
# clean_up_statsd_socket! sits below --min-lines only because of blank-line
# counting — same copy.)
Mastodon::Middleware::SocketCleanup#clean_up_redis_socket!
# Identical case-on-action boilerplate in three Form batch classes; hoisting
# into Form::BaseBatch with per-class action hooks consolidates.
Form::EmailDomainBlockBatch#save
# Two files each define Paperclip::LazyThumbnail (ImageMagick original vs
# libvips port) — the Ruby analogue of the Rust same-name convention: one id,
# two units, and the pair row names the same id twice. Only the vips file is
# required anywhere (config/application.rb); the IM original is dead code, and
# deletion is the consolidation — the Modx judgment from the discourse set.
Paperclip::LazyThumbnail#needs_different_geometry?
# Shared status-key scope_for dispatching to a per-class status_scope; a
# shared mixin keeps behaviour intact (the update_post judgment from the
# discourse set). Provisional: the two classes are otherwise unrelated, so
# the mixin is a weaker win than the batch/base-class rows above.
Admin::AppealFilter#scope_for
# --- convention dispatch: byte-identical, DISTINCT, mastodon's sharp edge ----
# Rails mailer actions: the body never names the template or the i18n subject
# key — both derive from the action's own name. Byte-identical bodies run
# different mail. Consolidating needs define_method metaprogramming, so under
# DEC-020 these are not findings — exactly the `super` arithmetic (DEC-017),
# but through a Rails convention normalization cannot see. The exact tier
# currently groups all four rows (7-, 2-, 2- and 2-strong groups).
UserMailer#password_change
UserMailer#two_factor_enabled
UserMailer#appeal_approved
UserMailer#suspicious_sign_in
AdminMailer#end_of_support_three_months_warning
# A migration embeds its own frozen copy of an app model's method. The group
# is class `mixed` (DEC-022) so it is still reported — but migration history
# cannot be consolidated with live code, so it is not a finding. The
# mixed-class cousin of discourse's migration FP class.
AccountConversation.add_status
# --- true near-duplicates: copy-paste, then tweaked --------------------------
# The remote-edit service copied Create's per-emoji block and wrapped it in a
# loop (return -> next). A shared per-tag helper consolidates 17 lines (0.74).
ActivityPub::Activity::Create#process_emoji
# Identical feed-clearing pipeline; only the key type and the unpush call
# differ, both already parameterized elsewhere in the class (0.74).
FeedManager#clear_from_home
# The local-edit and remote-edit services copied the same poll rescheduling;
# the remote copy then gained two guards (votes.exists?, the #37948 re-expiry
# fix) the local copy lacks — drifted-bugfix duplication, the best kind to
# surface (0.60, below the threshold).
UpdateStatusService#queue_poll_notifications!
# Same batch-index loop as the byte-identical pair above; accounts swaps the
# scope line for an includes-scope (0.67, below the threshold).
Importer::InstancesIndexImporter#import!
# Identical password-or-username challenge; one tail saves under a redis
# lock, the other validates. One shared verify_challenge helper, two thin
# callers — the Macaddr judgment from the rails set (0.71).
Form::Redirect#valid_with_challenge?
# Identical media-attachment JSON-LD builder; one guard predicate and one
# type string differ — a two-argument helper consolidates 14 lines (0.57,
# far below the threshold).
SEO::SocialMediaPostingSerializer#video
# Same subscription hash; three values sourced from doorkeeper vs the active
# session. A parameterized builder consolidates. Provisional: the differing
# sources are auth context, so the reduction is modest (0.64).
Api::V1::Push::SubscriptionsController#web_push_subscription_params
# The filter family's scaffold outside the byte-identical trio: same
# param-loop, differing initial scope and final chain. The same base-class
# template consolidates the whole family. Provisional: close to the
# "class hierarchy IS the consolidation" line the discourse set drew for
# scorables (0.85 — currently reported).
Admin::StatusFilter#results
# 34 lines of identical decay scoring copied between tag and link trends;
# history source and upsert target differ. A shared scorer with two hooks is
# a real reduction, but a wide one. Provisional (0.58).
Trends::Tags#calculate_scores
